description: Retrieve CIGO cleanroom/HVAC filter specifications for BFU, FFU or all. Returns representative photos, example dimensions, supply scope, pressure/efficiency conditions, official inquiry links and published glass-fiber versus nanofiber power measurements, including BFU at 17 CMM. This lookup returns product data, not an original test document, quote, order or guaranteed site energy saving. Custom unit components and international shipping require staff confirmation. Optional usage analytics and correlation are described below. Product lookups record channel labels and returned product codes for Cigo's usage analytics. The optional journey_token is a server-issued correlation value linking lookups and a later inquiry in the same customer conversation. Omission starts a new lookup journey.
name: get_hvac_filter_info
title: Get Hvac Filter Info
